title: Find a safer U-VEND Standardnr. route through card, personalization or page inspection
purpose: Recover the U-VEND Default Nos. setup route after the visible checkbox route and the marked DOM checkbox route could not be trusted.
entryCriteria: TARGET-036D2B result exists and is blocked before setup change.
Business Central context is playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
The next route must not rely on raw row coordinates or an untrusted checkbox locator.
stopIf: The active instance is not playthru.
The active company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
U-VEND row is not uniquely visible.
A dialog asks to save, confirm setup, create a record, post, preview, delete or switch company.
The route would change any value before a trusted field/page mapping is documented.
acceptanceCriteria: A safer route is documented for U-VEND Standardnr. setup, or the blocker is narrowed to a specific missing UI affordance.
No setup value is changed in this case.
No Preview Posting, Posting, payment, API shortcut or company switch occurs.
The next case is either a narrow controlled U-VEND write case or a documented alternative numbering decision.

nextStepDecisionCard.reason: The vendor retry still needs a supported U-VEND numbering decision. D2C is read-only and only discovers whether a safer route exists.

result: Page Inspection proved Page 456/Table 308 and Default Nos./Manual Nos. fields for U-VEND read-only; More Options row-menu evidence is not a U-VEND value proof.
proved: Business Central stayed in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
U-VEND was inspected read-only on Number Series Page 456.
No setup, master data, document, Preview Posting, Posting, payment, API shortcut or company switch occurred.
At least one route signal was visible enough for a follow-up route-decision case.
Page Inspection exposed the No. Series page/table and field identifiers read-only; this is a technical field-list proof, not a U-VEND value proof.
notProved: U-VEND Standardnr. / Default Nos. is not proven active.
Manual Nos. / Manuelle Anz. is not changed or proven active.
Page Inspection does not prove a persisted U-VEND checkbox value in this read-only case.
The More Options row-menu screenshot is not a U-VEND value proof because Business Central can move list focus while opening row menus.
No vendor creation retry is allowed from this case alone.
No legal numbering, posting group, VAT, payment term, document, Preview Posting or Posting behavior is proven.
warnings: D2C is read-only and must not be treated as a setup-fit proof.
Checkbox grid values on Business Central lists need a route with row/field certainty before any write.
Screenshot QA must distinguish selected-row proof from general action/menu inventory; row focus can drift on Business Central lists.
